messages:
Priya: Quick QTR closure check — can we get one-line status on owners' milemarkers? shipped/slipped/unblocked? Posting condensed so execs can copy.

Mateo: Shipping: runtime v2 canary finished; 95p latency target met. Owner: Mateo. Docs PR in review. Next: full rollout 03/22. :tada:

Alex: Slipped: evals infra (feature-gate) — blocked by storage migration. Owner: Alex. ETA +2 weeks. Need SRE help for data-mover.

Jordan: Code-review pings: @Lina can you review docs PR #342? It's the last blocker for runtime rollout.

Lina: On it, aiming EOD. Quick note: found one typo in config example.

Sam: On SRE side — data-mover run scheduled tomorrow 01:00 PT. Will validate with checksum. @Alex please share migration checklist.

Alex: Posted checklist below — running in dry-run first, then live.
```bash
# dry-run
python infra/migrate_storage.py --src s3://old-bucket --dst s3://redwood-evals --dry-run
# live (after dry-run pass)
python infra/migrate_storage.py --src s3://old-bucket --dst s3://redwood-evals --batch-size 500
# verify
sha256sum data/* > checksums.txt
```

Mateo: Also slipped: embeddings A/B test didn't collect enough traffic due to client rollout lag. Owner: Mateo. Next: toggle in client 2.1 to 50% by Mon and re-run.

Priya: Quick risk matrix — do we need to push OKR metric deadline? If any major shipment misses SLO, propose extension? Keep short.

Jordan: Suggest we keep deadline but mark runtime v2 as "partial shipped" (canary meets perf, docs + full rollout pending). I'll update OKR doc with partial credit and owners.

Lina: Docs PR merged. @Mateo found mismatch in console screenshot with schema field "model_version" vs "model_tag" — will need a tiny screenshot update in prod.

Mateo: Fixed screenshot and pushed commit. tagging @deploy-bot to trigger staging deploy.

deploy-bot: staging-deploy triggered for commit abc123 — estimated 12m.

Sam: After staging passes, I'll run the regression suite and the migration verification. If green, schedule full rollout Fri 03/22 10:00 PT.

Priya: Two asks before I send the exec summary: (1) Alex/Sam — post migration outcome + checksum here after the run; (2) Jordan — update OKR doc with partial credit, owners, and next-step dates. Will send summary to execs by EOD.

Alex: Will post migration results and sha256 checksums after the job completes.

(React: :thumbsup: from Priya, Mateo)
